recreation_prompt_markdown:
Recreate a browser-native mobile portrait dress-up game called **Stitched Moon Atelier**. Preserve the mechanics of a simple paper-doll fashion game: start screen, four item categories, one selected item per category, immediate canvas redraw of the avatar, selected tile feedback, same-item blocked feedback, done/reveal result screen with confetti, restart back to customization, and mute toggle. Do not add timers, scoring, validation, failure, locked content, or drag/drop.

The new identity is gothic whimsical and Tim Burton inspired without using copyrighted characters: a long-limbed porcelain moon mannequin is styled in a crooked midnight atelier. Use procedural Canvas and CSS motifs: spiral crescent moon, dangling stitch threads, bat and moth accents, crooked wardrobes, dashed seam borders, bone/plum panels, angular limbs, mournful eyes, and stitched-mouth expression. Use Creepster and Cinzel from the approved font catalog. Keep the HUD readable and tappable on mobile, with Wigs, Bodice, Skirts, Shoes tabs and clear Reveal Portrait / Restyle controls.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source game truth
The original game is a browser-native canvas dress-up game. It starts from a title screen, enters an avatar customization scene, lets the player tap four category tabs, and lets one item per category be selected. The canvas redraws the fashion doll with chosen hair, top, bottom, and shoes. Pressing the done button triggers confetti and a result screen; restart returns to customization. There is no score, timer, collision, fail state, or outfit validation.

## Protected mechanics
- Native click/tap start button.
- Four tabs with one active category at a time.
- One selected index per category; selected tiles are visibly marked.
- Same selected tile is blocked and does not change state.
- Canvas redraw loop and responsive resize.
- Done/reveal opens result state and spawns confetti.
- Restart returns to customization without resetting the chosen outfit.
- Mute toggles audio state.

## Safe theming surfaces
- Title, copy, HUD labels, item names/icons/colors, panel styling, fonts, audio tone, result copy, toast/feedback copy.
- Canvas avatar shape language and clothing silhouettes so long as each category still maps to the same visual layer.
- Background scene, particles, confetti colors, and decorative props.

## Remixed target
Stitched Moon Atelier: a gothic whimsical dress-up game where the player styles a porcelain moon mannequin inside a crooked midnight costume cabinet. The mechanic remains expressive avatar customization; the world, focal identity, background, UI, and feedback are fully re-authored.
